question: How remember the one-hero rite across one-, two-, triad-, and six-spoked wheels?
premises: in one-spoked as in wheel, remember the one-hero rite
in two-spoked, the paired elsewhere; thus triad
in six-spoked, the same rite holds
inference: One-hero rite remembered uniformly across wheel-spoke counts.
uncertainties: ekavira-vidhi (one-hero rite) kept technical; dvyara/yamala/trika/sadasra stations open
plain_english: In one-spoked, as in the wheel, remember the one-hero rite — in two-spoked, the paired elsewhere; thus triad, in six-spoked.
